stem.en: An iron atom has atomic number 26 and mass number 56. How many neutrons are in its nucleus?

explanation.en: Mass number = protons + neutrons, so neutrons = 56 - 26 = 30. The atomic number gives the 26 protons, and the rest of the mass number must be neutrons.

hints.en: A counts protons and neutrons together. Z counts only the protons. Subtract.
